text: Ek ladki pehle 2.5 ghante 18 km/h aur phir 1.5 ghante 12 km/h ki raftaar se cycle chalaati hai. Usne kul kitne kilometre tay kiye?
Phone plan mein baat karne ke minute 200 se badhkar 250 ho gaye. Naye 250 minute mein kitne pratishat ki kami karne par phir 200 minute bachenge?
Baag mein boond-boond sinchaai wali pipe se har minute 300 mL paani nikalta hai. 4.5 litre paani nikalne mein kitne minute lagenge?
Phone plan ka talk-time allowance 200 se 250 minutes ho gaya. New allowance mein kitna percent reduction karne se 200 minutes milenge?
Ek dukaan mein Diwali ki ek kandeel ₹450 ki hai aur us par 20% chhoot hai. Seema 3 kandeel khareedti hai. Use kitna dena hoga?
Ek cyclist pehle 2.5 hours tak 18 km/h se aur phir 1.5 hours tak 12 km/h se cycle chalati hai. Total kitne km ride kiya?
Lohe ki kadhaai ki khareed keemat aur bechne ki keemat ka anupaat 5:6 hai. Kadhaai ₹1500 mein khareedi thi. Use bechne par kitna munaafa hoga?
Ek quilt banaane waali red aur blue patches 2:3 ke ratio mein lagaati hai. Total 45 patches hain. Kitne blue patches lage?
Ek transport company ke paas 9 buses hain. Kuch mein 40 seatein aur baaki mein 52 seatein hain. Sabhi buses milaakar 396 seatein hain. 52 seat waali kitni buses hain?
Ek recurring deposit (RD) ki yojana mein har mahine ₹750 jama karne hote hain. 2 saal mein kul kitne rupaye jama honge?
Ek test mein 36 sawaal the aur Tanya ne 27 ke sahi jawaab diye. Usne kul sawaalon ka kitna hissa sahi kiya? Jawaab sabse saral bhinn mein do.
Hostel ke straight corridor mein entrance se distance marked hai. Water fountain 7 m par hai. Cupboard fountain se 5 m door aur entrance se zyada door hai. Cupboard ka metre mark kya hai?
Cricket team ko jeetne ke liye 260 run chahiye. Dono opening batsmen ne 94 run banaye aur middle-order batsmen ne 117 run aur jode. Ab jeetne ke liye kitne run chahiye?
Garden ka thermometer actual temperature se 2°C kam dikhata hai. Abhi reading -1°C hai. Actual temperature kya hai?
Hospital ₹2100 ka grant do teams mein unke 8 aur 6 training hours ke ratio mein baantta hai. 8-hour team ko kitna milega?
Ek iron kadhaai ka cost price aur selling price 5:6 ratio mein hain. Cost price ₹1500 hai. Ek kadhaai par kitna profit hoga?
Kiran ke paas 600 gram beej the. Usne unmein se 3/5 hissa sabzi ki kyaari mein boya. Kitne gram beej bach gaye?
Hospital do teams ko unke 8 aur 6 ghante ki training ke hisaab se ₹2100 ka fund baantta hai. 8 ghante wali team ko kitne rupaye milenge?

Hostel ke seedhe galiyaare mein darwaaze se doori metre mein likhi hai. Paani ka fawwara 7 m par hai. Almaari fawware se 5 m door hai aur darwaaze se uske aage hai. Almaari kis metre ke nishaan par hai?
School ne ₹350 ki footballs aur ₹600 ke cricket bats khareede. Total 10 items par ₹4750 diye. Kitni footballs khareedi?
School trip par har student ke ₹650 lagenge. Class ke 38 students ne ab tak ₹22000 jama kiye hain. Ab kitne rupaye aur jama karne honge?
School ne ₹350 ki football aur ₹600 ke cricket bats khareede. Kul 10 samaan khareede aur ₹4750 diye. Kitni football khareedi gayi?
Baag ka thermometer asal temperature se 2 degree Celsius kam dikhata hai. Abhi woh -1 degree Celsius dikha raha hai. Asal temperature kitna hai?
Ek RD (recurring deposit) scheme mein har month ₹750 deposit karne hain. 2 years mein total kitne rupaye jama honge?

Hostel mein raat ke 120 khaane parose gaye. Unmein 40% shaakaahaari hain. Shaakaahaari khaanon mein se 25% mein doodh ya doodh se bani cheezein nahi hain. Kitne shaakaahaari khaanon mein doodh se bani cheezein hain?
Garden ki drip irrigation pipe se har minute 300 mL paani aata hai. 4.5 L paani nikalne mein kitne minutes lagenge?
Test ke 36 questions mein Tanya ne 27 correct kiye. Total questions ka kitna fraction sahi hua? Answer simplest form mein do.
Diwali lantern ka marked price ₹450 hai aur us par 20% discount hai. Seema 3 lanterns leti hai. Total kitna pay karna hoga?
Ek passenger train raaste mein 9 stations par 2-2 minute rukti hai aur 72 minute chalti hai. Poore safar mein kitne ghante lagte hain?
Phone par ek square image ka area 81 cm² hai. Agar uski side length x cm hai aur x² = 81, toh x kitna hai?
Hostel ke do dining rooms mein pehle 46 aur doosre mein 30 thaaliyan hain. Staff pehle room se 5 thaaliyan doosre mein le jaata hai. Ab pehle room mein kitni thaaliyan zyada hain?
Do phone plans ka monthly price same hai. First mein 180 aur second mein 240 talk minutes hain. First plan ka per-minute cost, second ke per-minute cost ka kitna guna hai?
Road trip mein first day aur second day ka distance ratio 4:3 tha. Second day family ne 210 km drive kiya. Dono din milaakar total kitna distance cover kiya?
Passenger train 9 stops par 2-2 minutes rukti hai aur 72 minutes chalti hai. Total journey kitne hours ki hogi?
Hostel ke do dining rooms mein 46 aur 30 plates hain. Staff 5 plates first room se second mein shift karta hai. Ab first room mein kitni plates zyada hain?
Hostel mein 6 din ke liye 2.4 kg chai-patti rakhi hai. Har din barabar matra ki patti se 40 litre chai banati hai. Ek litre chai mein kitne gram patti lagti hai?
Do classes mein abhi barabar students hain. Agar class A se 6 students class B mein jaayen, toh class B mein class A ke dugne students honge. Abhi har class mein kitne students hain?
Garden ke water tank ko ek tap 6 hours mein aur doosra 3 hours mein bharta hai. Dono taps ek saath kholein toh kitne hours lagenge?
Phone par ek chaukor tasveer dikh rahi hai, jiska kshetrafal 81 square cm hai. Agar har taraf ki lambaai x cm ho, toh x ka varg 81 hai. x kya hai?
Ek transport company ki 9 buses hain. Kuch buses mein 40 seats aur baaki mein 52 hain. Total 396 seats hain. 52-seat wali kitni buses hain?
Class A aur B mein abhi equal students hain. Agar A se 6 students B mein shift ho jaayen, toh B mein A se double students honge. Abhi har class mein kitne hain?
Ek worker har ghante 12 square metres deewar paint karta hai. 78 square metres paint karne mein kitne hours lagenge?

Do phone plans ka mahine ka daam same hai. Pehle mein 180 aur doosre mein 240 minute baat kar sakte hain. Pehle plan ke prati-minute kharch ko doosre plan ke prati-minute kharch se bhaag dene par kya milega?
